exceptions.rationale: This narrow pass-through chain does not authenticate or mutate state itself; it forwards the browser session and CSRF token to Identity, which validates both. The gateway's own authenticated BFF chain retains CSRF protection. Re-reviewed 2026-10-12: the source changes add same-origin Blaze/admin return paths; the local Identity pass-through chain and authenticated BFF CSRF enforcement are unchanged. Re-reviewed 2026-10-14 for DLV-810: Identity pass-through remains local-only and unchanged; BFF session CSRF remains enabled. Lower-cost DEV adds idle filtering and GET/HEAD-only safe static routes behind the separate fail-closed admission filter; authenticated API matchers still precede fallback. Exception remains limited to the existing local pass-through rule; no expiry extension. Fresh hosted CodeQL remains required.

The browser reauthenticate=true parameter terminates session reuse by starting a fresh OAuth authorization flow; it never grants access or creates authentication. Reuse otherwise requires an OAuth2AuthenticationToken from the server security context, its stored authorized client, and Domain auth/me HTTP 200 using that client bearer and Gateway sign-in proof. Anonymous, missing-client and Domain-rejected sessions start OAuth. CloudGatewaySecurityIntegrationTest verifies these boundaries. Reviewed against the reported completed full scan; exact whole-source binding and expiry apply. Re-reviewed 2026-10-12: added review/staff proxy routes require server OAuth authentication and retain BFF CSRF, bounded bodies and fixed Domain upstream; the login reuse and forced-reauthentication logic is unchanged. Fresh hosted CodeQL analysis is still required. Re-reviewed 2026-10-14 for DLV-810: login/reuse/reauthenticate logic is unchanged. Logout now calls clearLearner, which invalidates the old session and clears SecurityContext, preserving only typed DEV admission state in a new session; admission is not learner authentication. Existing cloud login boundary and DEV logout tests remain required. No rule/path expansion or expiry extension; fresh hosted CodeQL remains required.
